evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies wallet coin selection and transaction creation logic in src/wallet/spend.cpp and spend.h.
rationale: Fixes an unhandled internal exception exposed over RPC when spending unconfirmed UTXOs in large mempool clusters. As described in issue #29711, transaction construction currently crashes with a cryptic 'map::at' exception when MiniMiner cluster limits (500 transactions) are exceeded; returning a descriptive error fixes a confusing failure in an uncommon edge case.
